overall_visual_style: Bold graphic illustration with high contrast, simplified shapes, strong silhouettes, minimal detail, and poster-like composition. Palette: deep navy, burnt orange, warm cream, cobalt blue, sun yellow. Lighting: graphic lighting with sharp value contrast and minimal shading. Mood: confident, modern, striking. Avoid: photorealism, any text, letters, numbers or logos, the name or look of a real artist, soft low-contrast scenes, busy fine detail.

shots.shot_goal: Name the viewer in the first second: show the familiar private moment of sitting and not starting, so the word in the narration lands as recognition.
shots.frame_composition: A small bedroom at grey dawn. One person sits alone on the edge of an unmade bed, feet flat on the floor, forearms on their knees, head low, body squared to the viewer. Medium shot from chest height with generous headroom and open space to the left. Behind them a bare wall in deep navy with hard burnt-orange slats of light thrown across it by a window blind just out of frame; warm cream floor, cobalt bedsheet. Flat graphic shapes, sharp value contrast, no clutter in the room.
shots.motion_plan: Very slow push-in on the seated figure with a faint upward drift, tightening from the whole bed to the person's shoulders and head; camera otherwise locked.
shots.source_support: The cited card opens with the reader having called themselves lazy, unmotivated or a procrastinator; the picture is the ordinary private moment of not getting started that this self-label describes, with no fact added beyond it.
shots.video_motion_intent: The person lets their shoulders slump and lowers their gaze, slowly, then holds still. The bedsheet stirs faintly. Face stays turned to the viewer.

shots.shot_goal: Introduce the coach as a figure with real volume of experience, without showing any real person's likeness, so his finding carries weight.
shots.frame_composition: A plain hall in warm cream. One anonymous figure in silhouette is seated in a simple wooden chair, seen from behind, shoulders relaxed, facing a wide sweeping arc of empty chairs that recedes row after row into deep navy shadow at the back of the room. Wide shot, low horizon, the seated figure small and centred in the lower third. Cobalt blue chair backs, a single shaft of sun-yellow light falling from a high window onto the empty rows. Graphic flat shapes, strong silhouettes, no faces visible.
shots.motion_plan: Slow push-in from the full hall toward the seated figure, with a slight rightward drift that lets the ranks of empty chairs slide past; camera locked otherwise.
shots.source_support: The card states Gary John Bishop coached thousands of people and heard the same self-labels constantly; the many empty chairs facing one anonymous seated coach pictures that scale, and the figure is shown from behind so no real person's likeness is drawn.

shots.shot_goal: Carry the reversal in the body: the person is not incapable, so they sit up and the excuse falls away.
shots.frame_composition: The same person from the opening, now seated upright in a straight-backed wooden chair in the middle of their bare apartment room, body squared to the viewer, hands resting open on their knees. Medium shot at eye level with clear headroom and open space on both sides. Behind them a closed door in deep navy, warm sun-yellow light burning along its edges as if a lit room waits beyond; warm cream wall, burnt-orange floorboards. Flat poster-like shapes, hard-edged light, nothing else in the room.
shots.motion_plan: Camera locked at a very slight pull-back that settles the figure and the closed door into the frame together, with a small downward settle at the end.
shots.source_support: The cited card says people were not incapable, merely unwilling, and that calling it a flaw let them off the hook; a capable person sitting up with an unopened lit door right behind them shows ability present and the choice untaken, adding no claim.
shots.video_motion_intent: The person straightens up in the chair and squares their shoulders, slowly, then holds still. Face stays turned to the viewer.

shots.shot_goal: Make the price of the goal physical, so the viewer feels the cost question before answering it.
shots.frame_composition: A narrow stairwell at night. The same person stands alone at the foot of a steep flight of stairs that climbs away in hard zigzag flights toward a small sun-yellow window high at the top of the frame. They are seen small in the lower third, back three-quarters to us, head tilted up at the climb; a heavy crate sits on the floor beside their feet. Wide vertical composition, deep navy walls, burnt-orange banister, warm cream treads catching the light from above. Flat graphic shapes, strong silhouette, minimal detail.
shots.motion_plan: Slow push-in that drifts upward along the stairwell, from the person at the bottom toward the distant lit window, camera locked.
shots.source_support: The card asks whether you are willing to do what the goal actually costs, giving wealth and eighty-hour weeks as the example; a steep climb toward a far-off lit window with a heavy load waiting at the bottom pictures that price without naming any outcome the card does not state.

shots.shot_goal: Release the pressure: an honest no is permission, so the person stands unburdened and calm.
shots.frame_composition: The same person stands in their own open doorway, empty-handed, body squared to the viewer, chin level. Medium-close shot at eye level with headroom above and open space to their right. Warm cream light floods the doorway from behind them, throwing a clean graphic shape across burnt-orange floorboards; deep navy wall on the left, a cobalt doorframe. Calm, uncluttered room, flat poster-like shapes, sharp value contrast, no objects in their hands.
shots.motion_plan: Camera locked with a gentle easing pull-back that opens a little air around the figure as the frame settles.
shots.source_support: The card states that if the honest answer is no, that is not failure but clarity; a person standing still, empty-handed and unhurried in their own lit doorway shows relief and permission rather than any new event.
shots.video_motion_intent: The person's shoulders drop and release as they lift their head, slowly, then holds still. Face stays turned to the viewer.

shots.shot_goal: Show willingness as a stance with two equally strong answers: a door that opens and a line that is drawn.
shots.frame_composition: A bare, wide room in warm cream. The same person stands planted in the exact centre, feet apart, arms loose at their sides, body squared to the viewer. Medium-wide shot at eye level. On the left of the frame an open door pours sun-yellow light in a hard graphic wedge across the floor toward them; on the right a single deep navy line is scored straight across the floorboards and runs off the edge of the frame. Cobalt wall behind, burnt-orange floor, flat poster-like shapes, sharp value contrast, nothing else in the room.
shots.motion_plan: Slow lateral drift from the lit open doorway across to the drawn line, holding the standing figure near centre, with a barely perceptible scale settle; camera otherwise locked.
shots.source_support: The card says willingness is a stance, that saying I am willing opens a door toward action and saying I am unwilling draws a line in the sand, and that both are power; the open door and the drawn line give those two answers equal weight on either side of one standing figure.

shots.shot_goal: Close on quiet accountability: the same room, the same person, settled and looking straight back at the viewer.
shots.frame_composition: The same apartment room at dusk. The person sits in the straight-backed wooden chair beside the window, hands resting in their lap, body and face squared to the viewer, still and composed. Medium shot at eye level with clear headroom and quiet space on the left. Last burnt-orange light lies in a hard band across the warm cream wall; deep navy shadow fills the rest of the room, the door behind them closed, cobalt window frame. Flat graphic shapes, strong silhouette, minimal detail, no other objects.
shots.motion_plan: Very slow push-in with a faint upward drift that ends close on the seated figure, holding there as the reel finishes; camera locked.
shots.text_overlay: You have the life you tolerate
shots.source_support: The cards state that pretending to want what you were never willing to work for is what drains you, and that refusing to act means this is the life you have chosen; the person sitting still in the unchanged room, facing the viewer, pictures that chosen life without adding any outcome.
shots.video_motion_intent: The person settles back into the chair and lifts their head, slowly, then holds still. Face stays turned to the viewer.
